rulings.Case Title: 140 DUBOCE I1, LP VS. ANGELA BONNER ET AL
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for July 21, 2026. Line 9. PLAINTIFF 140 DUBOCE I1, LP MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT is DENIED without prejudice. Plaintiff argues that it is entitled to judgment as a matter of law on its cause of action for unlawful detainer based on nuisance. However, neither the Notice of Motion, the Memorandum of Points and Authorities, nor the proposed order submitted with the moving papers discuss what specific relief Plaintiff believes it is entitled to in connection with the requested judgment. The proposed judgment submitted with the moving papers, which includes not only possession of the premises and forfeiture of the rental agreement, but also past-due rent and holdover damages in an unexplained amount in excess of $10,000, is the only indication of the relief Plaintiff requests. Based on this requested relief, summary judgment is denied as Plaintiff has not shifted its initial burden of showing it is entitled to this relief in connection with this unlawful detainer action based on nuisance.=(501/CFH) Parties may appear in-person, telephonically or via Zoom (Video - Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849; or Phone Dial in: (669) 254-5252; Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849).
